description: Defines a static class CacheHelpers that provides utility methods for generating cache keys related to catalog items, brands, and types in the eShopWeb project.

classes.name: CacheHelpers
classes.description: A static utility class for generating cache keys and managing cache durations within the web application.

methods.name: GenerateCatalogItemCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a unique cache key for catalog items based on page index, page size, brand ID, and type ID.

methods.name: GenerateBrandsCacheKey
methods.description: Returns the cache key string for brands.

methods.name: GenerateTypesCacheKey
methods.description: Returns the cache key string for types.
